related_questions.question: How long should you wait to take a rapid COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: If you have symptoms, test immediately, and then test again per the instructions if your first result is negative. If you were exposed to someone who has COVID-19 and you do not have symptoms, wait at least 5 full days after your exposure before testing. If you test too early, you may have an inaccurate result.

related_questions.question: How accurate are rapid COVID tests at home?
related_questions.snippet: In general, at-home COVID tests are most effective when you have respiratory symptoms. A study published in the journal Microbiology Spectrum looked at Binax COVID tests and found that they picked up almost 90% of COVID cases when people had symptoms. But they only picked up about half of asymptomatic cases.
